components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled electric teal action for the main decision on a surface.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h13M13 6l6 6-6 6" /></svg>CONNECT DISCORD</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--primary, #33ccbb); color: var(--primary-foreground, #0a0f0e); font: 700 14px/20px Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent, #2db8a8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #33ccbb); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(2px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action that keeps the primary signal dominant.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(51, 204, 187, 0.3); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #ffffff; font: 700 14px/20px Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease, color 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #33ccbb; background: rgba(51, 204, 187, 0.1); color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #33ccbb; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(2px); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Sharp field treatment for configuration values and identifiers.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; color: #ffffff; } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55); font: 700 12px/16px Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field-control { display: block; width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(51, 204, 187, 0.2); border-radius: 0; background: #09110f; color: #ffffff; font: 14px/20px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; outline: none; transition: border-color 200ms ease; } .ds-field-control:focus-visible { border-color: #33ccbb; outline: 2px solid #33ccbb; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Fixed Navigation
components.description: Translucent fixed header with a teal mark and tracked navigation labels.
components.html: SHEETWEBDOCS
components.css: .ds-nav { position: fixed; top: 0; right: 0; left: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 97px; padding: 24px 32px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(51, 204, 187, 0.1); background: rgba(10, 15, 14, 0.6); color: #ffffff; backdrop-filter: blur(24px); } .ds-nav-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: #ffffff; font: 900 24px/28px Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-mark { display: grid; width: 48px; height: 48px; place-items: center; background: #33ccbb; color: #0a0f0e; } .ds-nav-mark svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-nav-accent { color: #33ccbb; } .ds-nav-link { padding: 8px 4px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: #33ccbb; font: 700 14px/20px Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 200ms ease, color 200ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { border-color: #33ccbb; color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #33ccbb; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-calendar { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(51, 204, 187, 0.2); border-radius: 0; background: #0f1615; color: #ffffff; } .ds-calendar-head { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 40px 1fr 40px; align-items: center; min-height: 56px; padding: 8px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(51, 204, 187, 0.2); text-align: center; font: 900 14px/20px Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.025em; } .ds-calendar-arrow { display: grid; width: 36px; height: 36px; place-items: center; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #33ccbb; font-size: 24px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-calendar-arrow:hover, .ds-calendar-arrow:focus-visible { background: rgba(51, 204, 187, 0.1); } .ds-calendar-arrow:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #33ccbb; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-calendar-days { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, minmax(0, 1fr)); } .ds-calendar-days span { display: grid; min-height: 56px; place-items: center; border-right: 1px solid rgba(51, 204, 187, 0.1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(51, 204, 187, 0.1); color: rgba(51, 204, 187, 0.6); font: 700 11px/16px Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .ds-calendar-days span:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-calendar-days .ds-calendar-selected { background: rgba(51, 204, 187, 0.12); color: #33ccbb; }

narrative.overview:
SheetWeb treats the interface like a compact control room for a live Discord shift. A green-black canvas carries a bright electric teal signal. Large, heavy Inter headlines, square control surfaces, thin borders, and small uppercase labels make state and action easy to spot.

The system is high contrast and operational, with a little visual voltage. The landing page uses diagonal grid texture, floating hexagons, tilted cards, teal glow, and short hover transitions. Authenticated screens keep the same language in a denser layout, with split panels, schedule grids, and clear role-based navigation.
keyCharacteristics: Dark green-black canvas with an electric teal signal.
Heavy Inter hierarchy with uppercase, letter-spaced labels.
Square surfaces and thin translucent teal rules.
Tonal layering first, selective glow and motion for emphasis.
Asymmetric landing compositions and dense operational dashboards.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Use electric teal for actions, active states, system labels, and key status. Let the green-black field carry most of the screen.

rules.name: The Wash Rule
rules.body: Treat deep teal wash as a background layer. It supports the signal instead of competing with it.

rules.name: The Weight Rule
rules.body: Reserve the heaviest weights for hierarchy and action. Use regular body text for explanation instead of making every line compete.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep operational surfaces flat and legible. Use shadow, glow, rotation, or scale only when a featured element needs extra attention or when a state change needs a clear response.

dos: Do keep the main canvas deep green-black and use deep teal wash for the background of standard panels.
Do use electric teal as the primary signal for actions, active states, labels, and focus.
Do use square corners for controls and panels, reserving full rounding for avatars and small image treatments.
Do use heavy Inter for hierarchy and tracked uppercase labels for system context.
Do use thin rules, grid structure, and tonal contrast to make operational state scannable.
Do keep motion short and purposeful, especially on high-frequency dashboard controls.
donts: Don't introduce rounded cards, pill-shaped controls, or soft SaaS styling as the default language.
Don't replace the deep green-black and electric teal world with a light canvas or a new primary accent without an explicit redesign decision.
Don't put heavy shadows on every surface. Reserve them for landing-page emphasis and clear elevation states.
Don't make every label, paragraph, and icon equally loud. Preserve the display, title, body, and metadata hierarchy.
Don't use rotation, glow, or scale on controls that people need to scan repeatedly during a live shift.
